entry_methods.method: Catch the 96 KB boot ROM USB-download window on an already-wired Type-C port: leave D+/D− connected to USB_DP J17 / USB_DN H17 (LDO_USB / VUSB K17 / Avdd1p8_USB L17 up), start a Mac USB watch for any new device first (VID unknown), then re-enter ROM by pulsing RESET D2 high or PWRON_L C1 (low / high pulse, min 10 ms) so ROM can enumerate as a USB 2.0 HS / Type-C-compliant device before a valid flash image jumps to the user app. Datasheet documents UART-or-USB downloading; it does not name a BOOT-strap GPIO, timeout, or VID/PID.

Public BES programmer workflow on a wired USB port: arm the host watcher, then power-cycle the DUT (off then on) while the cable stays plugged so the boot ROM download path is re-entered; dld_main docs say click Start then turn the device off and on again. Same window as RESET/PWRON_L; does not keep ROM after a valid user image has already booted.

Documented sibling of the same boot ROM downloader if USB does not appear: UART download on GPIO_P0_0 UART1_RXD / GPIO_P0_1 UART1_TXD or LED3 T3 (one-wire UART). This is not a USB enumeration path; factory R/W on the running user image is also UART eshell, not MSC.

known_vid_pid.source: BES2700BP Datasheet v1.2 USB / pin chapters list USB_DP J17, USB_DN H17, LDO_USB, VUSB, Avdd1p8_USB and UART-or-USB downloading, but no vendor/product ID. Official usb.ids (2026-06-26) has no Bestechnic/BE57 ROM-download pair. Do not treat MediaTek 0x0E8D (TEARDOWN.md BROM watch) as this SoC.

conclusion: On a wired Type-C port, catch ROM USB by leaving the cable plugged and pulsing RESET D2 (high) or PWRON_L C1 while the Mac already watches for any new USB device (VID unknown — not MediaTek 0x0E8D) so the 96 KB boot ROM can enumerate on USB_DP J17 / USB_DN H17 before flash takes over; public silicon docs give UART-or-USB downloading and LDO_USB/VUSB/Avdd1p8_USB but no VID/PID and no BOOT GPIO. After that window the 1.0.12.83 user image never enumerates (no hal_usb/gadget stack; factory R/W is UART eshell md/mw/xmodem), and ENGINEER_MODE key-hold is MMI in the running app, not ROM USB.
